scope: Approval feedback and user-input final submission failure/retry; three bounded candidate groups: current host/tests, original local callback/progression, concrete ViewAction owner dispatch. No product changes.

current_host_defects.conclusion: Final record removes current custom draft and clears text, retains answers privately and emits the complete submit event. Owner failure only sets inputFailure/inputUnavailable. The form has no pending-submission retry action. After error, the field is blank and its button is Skip; tapping that emits dismiss rather than retrying the saved complete answer payload.
current_host_defects.limit: Answers are not destroyed by record; they remain in the live draft. User can reconstruct a final answer or choose an option again. The exact complete submission event is not retained for one-step retry, and form destruction retires private answers.

current_host_defects.conclusion: Feedback submit clears local text before onAction. A disconnected or local-write failure keeps the request but discards the field copy; its empty button becomes Deny. No failed feedback event is retained in the view for retry.
current_host_defects.limit: Source lower-level clearing order matches observed293 local callback; missing host owner acknowledgement/rollback is the integration gap.

current_host_defects.conclusion: approve() lacks the isEnabled guard that answer() has. The current sole UI caller invokes it only inside if replay.isEnabled, so ordinary UI admission is already guarded. The store entry itself is not protected from another direct caller.
current_host_defects.limit: Do not report the ordinary UI as currently bypassing the replay switch. Consistent store-level admission is recommended to preserve the invariant for future consumers.

current_host_defects.conclusion: Existing tests assert clear-before-callback and validate disconnected/stale events. UI test checks approval request/control retention after failure. None of these snippets verifies original text/full final answer can be retried without re-entry; keeping a request visible is weaker than preserving its submission draft.
current_host_defects.limit: Tests were reviewed, not executed by this evidence-only task. Historical reports of passing tests are not new runtime proof.

official_observations.conclusion: Original feedback trims whitespacesAndNewlines, clears local state before forwarding nonempty Redacted<String>. Empty keyboard submit is no-op; the separate button can deny. A local clear is not evidence of final service success.

Original custom answer writes one-element answer array by questionID after removing current custom draft/clearing text; progression chooses unanswered questions and invokes supplied submit closure when all answer keys are present. Answers and unsubmitted custom drafts are separate state. Request-key change clears the maps/index/text.
official_observations.limit: No submit-failure retry/acknowledgement contract follows from these local callbacks.

official_observations.conclusion: The concrete model has separate owner action paths for complete user-input answers, approval decisions, denial and redacted feedback. The original view callback is an owner handoff, not an immediate service receipt.
official_observations.limit: Tags are local binary enum tags, not protocol opcodes. Generic owner witness binding limitations from ios-remote-pending-owner-20261113-findings.json still apply; concrete handler action matching is corroboration.

official_observations.conclusion: Original input submission owner checks a stored userInputSubmissionTask before the continuation. This is a separate task-lifecycle admission boundary, beyond per-question text clearing.
official_observations.limit: Only bounded prefix0x18e73e0..0x18e75a0 was inspected. Full task construction, result/catch handling, pending request removal, receipt and failure UI remain unresolved. Field naming does not by itself prove retry or cancellation policy.

frontend_adapter_recommendation.authority: Independent frontend transaction design; original asynchronous failure semantics not recovered.
frontend_adapter_recommendation.current_sync_owner: Preserve source-modeled low-level clear-before-forward by copying draft into next. Run submit/select against next. If no final event, commit next so intermediate question navigation works. If an event exists, invoke synchronous owner admission; commit next only when accepted. On rejection keep before unchanged. Do not display success or dismiss a request for a rejected admission.
frontend_adapter_recommendation.effect_on_feedback: A rejected feedback send leaves original untrimmed field text, so button remains Send and retry regenerates the same trimmed scoped event. Empty keyboard remains no-op; empty deny uses its own admission result.
frontend_adapter_recommendation.effect_on_input: A rejected final text/choice preserves the state immediately before that final action, including previous answers and final draft/selection. Retrying regenerates complete answer dictionary. Intermediate successful selections still advance. Do not persist secret answers merely to implement retry.
frontend_adapter_recommendation.future_async: Use separate scoped pending attempt (request identity+question/catalog revision+attemptID) with redacted in-memory full payload. Block duplicate dispatch or share one in-flight attempt. Distinguish dispatch from authoritative acceptance. An old result must not erase newer edits or a replacement request; restore only if current owner/attempt/revision still matches. Rejected retry may preserve current user edits rather than overwrite them.
frontend_adapter_recommendation.receipt_boundary: Current replay answer/approve copies state, resolves request, begins visible turn and commits it before returning nil. Failure returns without publishing the copied state. A draft admission wrapper can use that nil/non-nil result as the current synthetic acceptance boundary; it is not an official server contract.
frontend_adapter_recommendation.approve_guard: Add isEnabled guard at the store method entry for consistency; current outer UI guard remains. This is independent defensive wiring, not a recovered293 condition.

proposed_regressions: Final ordinary/secret answer with disconnected owner retains text and complete prior answers; second submit reproduces identical scoped payload.
Final option rejected keeps prior selection/drafts and retry can reconstruct full dictionary.
Intermediate answer event=nil still commits index change and per-question state.
Approval feedback disconnected/localStorage/stale rejection retains untrimmed text; retry uses same trimmed payload; deny is never triggered by data loss.
Successful admission clears exactly once and removes pending controls through current owner receipt.
Request/host/connection replacement retires pending attempt; old completion cannot clear current draft.
Direct approve() on disabled replay cannot mutate/commit/schedule.
No secrets in ordinary debug output or persistence.
